jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst
jobs.description: Cybersecurity Analyst Company: JobSPhere Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time Duration: 3 Months Compensation: Performance-Based, up to ₹25,000/- ABOUT THE COMPANY JobSPhere is focused on creating opportunities for aspiring technology professionals through practical projects and industry-oriented learning. We value innovation, digital awareness, and the importance of maintaining secure technology environments. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a dedicated Cybersecurity Intern interested in identifying security vulnerabilities, understanding cyber threats, and protecting digital systems. The selected candidate will gain practical exposure to security monitoring, vulnerability assessment, risk analysis, and cybersecurity practices under appropriate supervision. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Monitor systems and networks for potential security threats. Assist with vulnerability assessments. Research emerging cyber threats and security vulnerabilities. Analyze security alerts and suspicious activities. Support basic security testing in authorized environments. Assist in implementing security best practices. Prepare security assessment reports and documentation. Research methods to improve system and application security. ELIGIBILITY Pursuing or completed a degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Freshers and experienced candidates can apply. Interest in ethical hacking and information security. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. REQUIRED SKILLS Networking fundamentals and TCP/IP. Familiarity with Linux and Windows. Basic knowledge of cybersecurity concepts. Understanding of common cyber threats. Familiarity with Nmap or Wireshark is an advantage. Basic awareness of web application security. Good research and documentation skills. PERKS & BENEFITS Performance-based compensation up to ₹25,000/-. Practical exposure to cybersecurity projects. Opportunity to explore security tools and technologies. Professional learning and development. Experience with vulnerability assessment and threat analysis. Internship certificate upon successful completion. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY JobSPhere welcomes candidates from diverse backgrounds and promotes an inclusive, collaborative, and supportive workplace.

jobs.title: Graduation Intern Information Security & Privacy
jobs.description: Company team.blue is an ecosystem of 60+ successful brands working together across 22 European countries to provide its 3.3 million SMB customers with everything they need to succeed online by offering best-in-class expertise and services. team.blue's brands are a mix of traditional hosting businesses that offer services from domain names, email, shared hosting, e-commerce, and server hosting solutions and, as specialist SaaS providers, adjacent products such as compliance, marketing tools, and team collaboration products. This broad product offering makes it a one-stop partner for online businesses and entrepreneurs across Europe. Position We are looking for a Graduation Intern Information Security & Privacy to join our Quality, Information Security & Sustainability (QIS) team in the Netherlands. This internship offers a unique opportunity to contribute to one of the most relevant challenges in today's digital landscape: the responsible use of AI and personal data. As part of your graduation project, you will evaluate how human oversight of AI-generated outputs works in practice across team.blue brands and develop a practical intervention that helps teams identify, assess, and safeguard AI-related privacy risks earlier and more consistently. You will work closely with Information Security, Privacy, and business stakeholders while gaining hands-on experience in AI governance, risk management, and data protection within an international technology organization. Location: Leiden, Netherlands (Hybrid) Duration: February 2027 – June 2027 Hours: 32 hours per week (4 days) Reporting to: Regional CISO Netherlands Responsibilities Research AI use cases within team.blue NL that involve the processing of personal data. Analyse and classify AI use cases based on privacy and security risks. Conduct interviews with employees and stakeholders to understand how human review of AI-generated outputs is performed in practice. Perform a Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) together with process owners and privacy specialists. Design, pilot, and evaluate a practical intervention that improves the governance and assessment of AI-related risks. Create an implementation plan to support adoption of the proposed solution. Support the QIS team with reviews of AI tools, integrations, and privacy-related questions from various brands. Present findings, recommendations, and project outcomes to relevant stakeholders and the Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) panel. Profile Currently pursuing an HBO Bachelor's degree, preferably in Integrale Veiligheidskunde or a related field. Strong interest in Information Security, Privacy, AI Governance, Risk Management, or Compliance. Knowledge of privacy principles, responsible data usage, and AI-related risks. Excellent analytical and research skills. Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities. Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of a graduation project. Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
